g.text: compose.yaml + compose.caddy.yaml / only the edge publishes ports.
KEY: blue AWS | green service | brown data | red identity | gray external | solid core | dashed option
Default public name: ok.<domain>. Caddy targets ok-auth, never open-knowledge.
Optional names: agent / llm / ov use edge-agent / edge-llm / edge-ov, AdminCidr and each service key.
Internal: db, llm, memory, knowledge, knowledge-agent and the four edge resource networks.
knowledge: gate + OpenKnowledge only. knowledge-agent: agent + OpenKnowledge only. OpenKnowledge uses port 80.
Gate networks: knowledge, gate-egress, edge-ok. edge-ok: 198.18.5.0/29, edge + gate only.
Internet routes: egress, gate-egress, edge-core. The gate is the only member of gate-egress.
The agent shares egress with the gateway, also with web search off.
Rendered core: 7 services / 12 networks. Copilot: 8 / 13. Pangolin: 9 / 12. Both options: 10 / 13.
The agent uses http://ok.<domain>/mcp, an internal alias. OpenKnowledge makes no model call.
Frames group related parts. Dashed component boxes mark options; all other component boxes mark the core.
